statements.proposition: This change makes no breaking changes to the existing Cases API, and showing merged cases in list/search is opt-in through include_merged=true (default false).
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Impact claim, settled structurally from the full diff (not executed): no public name, route, field or parameter was removed or renamed; the only removed lines are three short_id format expressions (replaced by an equivalent with a None fallback), one import line widened, and a comment. Response models only gain fields with defaults; list_cases and search_cases gain include_merged with default False; new routes are additions. Existing data has no merge rows, so the new exclusion filter changes nothing for it. Residual judgment: whether additive response fields and the new 'cannot change status of a merged case' rule (applies only to newly merged cases) count as breaking.
